title: The Confetti That Rose Into the Sky
central_conflict: the parade confetti floated upward instead of falling around the performers
decisive_choice: warm air rising from the bakery chimneys lifted everything in that lane
resolution: moved the confetti display away from the chimneys and caught the paper for reuse
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the parade confetti floated upward instead of falling around the performers before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they switched to heavier paper but it still drifted above the roofs; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized warm air rising from the bakery chimneys lifted everything in that lane; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they moved the confetti display away from the chimneys and caught the paper for reuse, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Violin That Lost Its Voice
central_conflict: the lead violin barely made a sound during the dress rehearsal
decisive_choice: oil from a spilled costume bottle had coated the bow hair and removed its grip
resolution: cleaned the affected equipment safely and restored the bow's rosin
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the lead violin barely made a sound during the dress rehearsal before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they tightened every string but the bow still slid silently across them; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized oil from a spilled costume bottle had coated the bow hair and removed its grip; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they cleaned the affected equipment safely and restored the bow's rosin, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Harvest Count That Doubled
central_conflict: the farmers' ledger showed twice as many crates as the barn could hold
decisive_choice: the clerk had entered both the original receipt and its carbon copy as separate loads
resolution: matched receipt numbers to real crates and corrected the public tally
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the farmers' ledger showed twice as many crates as the barn could hold before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the road for missing deliveries but found none; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the clerk had entered both the original receipt and its carbon copy as separate loads; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they matched receipt numbers to real crates and corrected the public tally, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
